title: 报告期和披露日不可混用
concept: 截止分析日只能使用已披露的报告、审计意见和治理数据；重述版本按其自身披露时间进入历史样本
operational_consequence: as_of filter uses latest actual disclosure date; never use future restatements
source: 比赛数据字典与Tushare接口字段说明

title: Beneish M-Score 研究模型
concept: 观察应收、毛利、资产质量、折旧、费用、杠杆和应计等财务操纵模式相关特征；美国样本历史模型
operational_consequence: only non-financial comparable annual data; show components and missing values; do not label probability or misconduct

title: Piotroski F-Score 财务质量九信号
concept: 盈利性、流动性与运营效率的九项二元变化信号；属于价值投资与基本面研究
operational_consequence: missing new-equity issuance info implies partial score; never call a fraud detector

title: Altman Z双撇 新兴市场版本
concept: 综合营运资本、留存收益、盈利、账面权益相对负债等描述性财务结构
operational_consequence: with +3.25 intercept do not silently reuse cutoffs from non-intercept variant; exclude financial firms

title: 利润与经营现金流差异
concept: 净利润与经营现金流之间差异可揭示收入确认、营运资本波动等；并非单凭此确定操纵
operational_consequence: use aligned reporting periods and comparable net income; versioned research threshold

title: 司法记录的主体身份匹配
concept: 同名不是同一主体；法院案件应区分调查、指控、生效裁判、撤销和未核查状态
operational_consequence: never auto-escalate to legal violation; human verifier required

title: 审计意见与审计师变化
concept: 非标准审计意见与审计师变更可以作为加强调查线索，但具体意见意义需要读取原始报告
operational_consequence: prefer structured fina_audit fields; title-only fallback explicitly tagged title_only

title: 公司质押比例与控股股东个人质押比例
concept: 公司整体质押占总股本比例与控制人已持股的质押比例不可互换
operational_consequence: report issuer_pledge_ratio_pct only; needs actual holder-level source for controller numerator/denominator

title: 监管文件版本变化与法定义务
concept: 规则更新的标题、发布日期、生效日与适用主体是不同字段；规则消失可能是采集问题
operational_consequence: review amended vs new; do not infer repeal or legal effect from missing snapshot
